newsitem.title: USA: St. Louis Cardinals eye new baseball stadium.
newsitem.headline: St. Louis Cardinals eye new baseball stadium.

text.p: The St. Louis Cardinals baseball team is eyeing a new ballpark for the future, the team's president said Monday. Mark Lamping said while the team's current home, 31-year-old Busch Stadium, has 10 to 15 years of useful life left, the franchise wants to get a jump on plans for a new stadium.
"We have no location, no funding strategy," Lamping said.
However, he added that the team expects to form a public-private partnership to build a new ballpark and will begin talks with state and local government officials.
